# TruCount CPA PC

> > TruCount CPA PC is a Brookings, SD-based accounting firm founded in 2009, serving farmers, agribusiness operators, and professional service businesses across South Dakota, western Minnesota, and parts of Ohio. Led by Julie Underwood, CPA, the team includes members who grew up on farms and speak the language of agriculture firsthand. TruCount bundles bookkeeping, payroll, tax, and advisory into fixed monthly-fee packages delivered through a secure online platform, emphasizing deep, personal client relationships over routine quarterly check-ins — helping clients know their numbers before surprises happen.
